name: deck-design
description: Build slide decks that survive critic review. Bundles three skills: deck-mindset (5-color vocabulary on dark backgrounds + 15pt floor + 3-tier hierarchy + 5 named layouts + 8 card families, plus template profiles — aurora-black for the AWS black master — with dated lessons and two case studies), deck-build (token module, pptxgenjs/python-pptx build patterns and a validate → render → inspect QA loop, with Korean-deck specifics: Latin in Amazon Ember, Korean in Noto Sans CJK KR), and deck-agent-team (Phase-2 review via parallel critic agents — visual + content + cognitive + compliance — with PASS/FAIL gate and human-checked patch apply). Use when designing, producing or auditing presentations that prioritize consistency and audience cognition over visual variety.
